title: Issues syncing files with names in unexpected charset encodings

labels.name: bug
labels.description: A problem with current functionality, as opposed to missing functionality (enhancement)

labels.name: frozen-due-to-age
labels.description: Issues closed and untouched for a long time, together with being locked for discussion

body:
Using Syncthing v0.8.12, Arch Linux, ext4 filesystem

Have a strange problem, I'm syncing about 181GB using syncthing, and it seems like some of the files are having a problem syncing. Here is a screenshot of the main window:

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6318224/3168622/4f3d511c-eb85-11e3-8542-6698981f85f2.png)

The size reported in the file manager is 181.1GB, 8348 items, just as the local repo sees. The same is true with the computer I am syncing with, "ThinkpadR61". I have both computers walk through the location first, before syncing them, and they show this stat. When I have them sync each other, mysteriously Syncthing reports that 8 files are not in sync between the machines, resulting in 8355 files, 182 GiB. Both machines report the same results in the screenshot (they both think they are out of sync). It should be noted that these two comptuers have had their data rsynced prior to syncthing running, so I believe the content is the same in any case.

Here is some of the output of STTRACE=model,scanner syncthing 2>&1 | tee ~/syncthing.log (full output not attached, since the log kept on dumping things to the output that was too long):
